title: save_data_mapping input
description: This domain's data sits here, or it left: saves up to 100 data mappings (O26), each with its origin and the container names as seen. A mapping is matched again on its domain, location and origin. An AI client's mapping is a draft until a person confirms it. A production copy or masked copy outside production is judged by the copy rule: never is refused for everyone (G-25), and a copy that needs a decision gets a proposed copy decision, which a person sends.

mappingId.description: The mapping to change, confirm or end.

domainKey.description: A domain at a declarable level.

containers.description: Container names as seen, such as tables. Empty means the whole location. Labels only, never data.

copiedFromMappingId.description: For a replica or a copy: the mapping it came from.

endOn.description: Ends the mapping on this date.

confirm.description: True confirms the mapping. A person's save confirms unless this is false. An AI client never confirms (G-21).

proposeCopyDecision.description: Open a copy decision for a copy outside production that needs one.
